prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up shot of a gloved hand holding a modern smartphone vertically against a plain, light-colored wall. The hand is wearing a sleek, black leather glove, suggesting a sense of mystery or intrigue. The smartphone screen is brightly illuminated, displaying a music streaming app with an album cover featuring dark, moody artwork and a playlist of song titles in a clean, modern interface. The lighting is soft and even, casting minimal shadows and emphasizing the smooth texture of the wall and the glossy surface of the phone. The color palette is muted and neutral, dominated by the pale background and the dark glove, with the phone screen providing a pop of vibrant color. The composition is minimalist, with the focus sharply on the hand and phone, creating a sense of intimacy and suspense. The camera angle is straight-on at eye level, with a shallow depth of field that subtly blurs the background, drawing attention to the central subjects. The overall style is cinematic and contemporary, evoking a mood of quiet tension or anticipation.
